title: statusline r6 UX: human-form cause+recovery never falsified
description: Round 6. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Owner: SO session. Defect: 'the segment marks, vsdd status in human form explains cause and recovery' is the sole degraded-day recovery route, but no criterion reaches the human form's explanatory text — superset covers display fields only, and cause/recovery is not a display field; the operator can arrive at the promised explanation and find the flag re-rendered. Hub pushes failed all day in the design sessions — the case is real. Citations verified: contract:163 vs :188, :199. Proposed: resolved-candidate (degraded fixtures: human form names the absent-or-unusable corroboration source and a recovery action).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: degraded fixtures' human form must name the absent-or-unusable corroboration source and a recovery action. Revision: Status detection criterion.
